CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No. ____
Station ____
Date ____ 19__
Subject. ____
Made by. J.J.D. MARKEVSKY Forwarded by. ____

〔此处转录不清〕

Information has been received to the effect that
a certain firm Messrs. ____ & ____ of ____ Szechuen Road
are desirous of disposing of their "old" stock of 350
Mausers of military type. Each Mauser with 300 rounds of
ammunition, two magazines (one for 10 and the other for 20
rounds) and woodenstock is priced at $ 8 - - - .
These Mausers are of Czecho-Slovakian manufacture,
Skoda Factory, and are part of the stock brought in
Shanghai some time ago for the Nationalist Government on
Luchas issued by that Government.
The firm is reported to be desirous of selling the
whole stock at once to some Chinese Government Institution
or authorised person with the knowledge of the local
Japanese Military Command.
One HIRSCH, a German Jew refugee is engaged in the
task of finding a suitable customer and he is being (Robin?)
assisted by two well-known arms dealers - LOUIS RUBIN,
an American and ROBERT LEE, a Eurasian.
So far their efforts have met with no success.

（批：D.C. Crime
Information
and favour of
passing to
Command.）

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

（批：C.P.
C.I. will
make inquiries
in this connection.）

（印：COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

（签名：J.J.D. Markevsky
J.S.I.）

接获情报称，
位于四川路（Szechuen Road）____ 号的某商号 ____ & ____ 先生
有意处置其 350 支军用型毛瑟枪的“旧”库存。每支毛瑟枪配弹 300 发，
两个弹匣（一个装 10 发，另一个装 20 发）及木质枪托，定价为 8-- 美元。
这些毛瑟枪系捷克斯洛伐克制造，出自斯柯达工厂（Skoda Factory），是此前
以该国政府发行的卢卡斯债券（Luchas）为国民政府运抵上海的部分库存。
据报，该商号希望在当地日本军事当局的知情下，
将整批库存一次性出售给某个中国政府机构或授权人员。
一名名为 HIRSCH 的德籍犹太难民正从事寻找合适买家的工作，
并有两名知名军火商协助他——美国人 LOUIS RUBIN 和欧亚混血儿 ROBERT LEE。
迄今为止，他们的努力未获成功。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S/S REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. ____
Social Branch, Station ____
Date ____ May 3, 1939.

Subject. Enquiries re American Film Advertising Company.

Made by. D.B. Pharaoun Forwarded by. Inspector **〔此处转录不清〕**

FILE

**〔此处转录不清〕**

I have to report that on the morning of
1-5-39, I interviewed Mr. LOUIS I. RAISIN of the
American Film Advertising Company at his offices on
the 7th floor of the Messageries Maritimes Building,
French Bund.

Mr. Raisin stated that his company is
embarking on a new form of cinema advertising in
Shanghai, namely that of moving advertisements
accompanied by sound explanation.

Mr. Raisin has a large suite of offices
and a special room where he prepares the advertisements,
working out the ideas for them himself. He ran me
off several samples on the projector and these appeared
to be of the type which would appeal to the public as
a new innovation. He expects to place his advertise-
ments in nearly all the Shanghai cinemas. The sound
track was not yet available but Mr. Raisin assured me
that it would be devoted exclusively to the advertise-
ment of the goods shown on the screen.

On the morning of 2-5-39, I interviewed
leading members of the film business in Shanghai and
they stated that they had not been approached in any
way by Mr. Raisin with a view to placing his products.

Later enquiries made at the American
Consulate-General showed that Mr. Raisin is a Russian
born naturalized American-Jew. His passport, No. 175921,
was issued at Washington in 1925. He was married in
Germany in 1923 and divorced in Shanghai on 12-4-38.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 4 MAY 1939 CRIME BRANCH）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 5 MAY 1939 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处登记室
编号 S. B. D. ____
特别处，警署 ____
日期 1939 年 5 月 3 日。

事由。 关于美国电影广告公司的查询。

制作人。 D.B. Pharaoun 转呈人。 督察 **〔此处转录不清〕**

卷宗

**〔此处转录不清〕**

兹报告如下：
1939 年 5 月 1 日上午，我在法外滩信使大楼（Messageries Maritimes Building）
七楼的办公室会见了美国电影广告公司的 LOUIS I. RAISIN 先生。

Raisin 先生表示，他的公司正在上海推行一种新型的电影广告形式，
即配有声音解说的动态广告。

Raisin 先生拥有一套宽敞的办公室和一间专门制作广告的房间，
广告创意均由他本人构思。他用放映机为我播放了几个样本，
这些样本看起来属于那种能作为新创举吸引公众的类型。他预计将其广告
投放到上海几乎所有的电影院。音轨部分尚未就绪，但 Raisin 先生向我保证，
声音将专门用于宣传屏幕上展示的商品。

1939 年 5 月 2 日上午，我会见了上海电影业的主要人士，
他们表示，Raisin 先生未曾就投放其产品一事与他们进行过任何接触。

随后在美国总领事馆进行的查询显示，Raisin 先生是一名出生于俄罗斯的
归化美籍犹太人。他的护照号码为 175921，于 1925 年在华盛顿签发。
他于 1923 年在德国结婚，并于 1938 年 4 月 12 日在上海离婚。

（印：副总监 1939 年 5 月 4 日 犯罪科）
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1939 年 5 月 5 日 总监办公室）
